one_liner: Snowflake exposes a REST SQL API (plus Cortex and other REST APIs) authenticated via OAuth or key-pair JWT (and PATs), with a free trial account path and a vendor-published MCP server, but each customer needs per-account setup.
auth_notes: Provided pages confirm OAuth and Key Pair for the SQL API. Programmatic access tokens (static secrets) are not confirmed by the provided pages; kept from the draft at low confidence. Each customer has their own account URL.
access_notes: The docs home page links to "Getting a Trial Account", so access via a time-limited trial is supported. The paid-account quote in the draft came from an unreadable PDF and was dropped. Ongoing use is consumption-billed (not verified by the pages).
blocker_notes: Free access is only through a trial account. Each customer also needs their own account URL and admin-configured OAuth or key-pair setup. Provided pages do not detail the trial limits.

evidence.quote: The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.
Use OAuth or Key Pair to authenticate with the Snowflake server.
